F1.why: Y units are contraction and possessive endings plus heading =, matching the parent.

F2.why: Y units fire on the @ of @-@ and heading = markers like the parent.

F3.why: The parent mixes @-@ hyphen, CJK bytes, headings and name fragments, each of which is one Y unit.

F4.why: Y has the unit word after a number (ft, metres) which matches the parent's ft part.

F5.why: Y units are closing quotes, apostrophes and possessive 's.

F6.why: Y units are the unit word after a number in measurements.

F7.why: Y units cover @ in numbers and hyphens and rare-word fragments, which the parent combines.
